improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the value proposition and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter—critical channels for reaching business owners and traders. Including the free searches hook in descriptions reduces friction and encourages clicks.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace to run your business smarter. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clarifies its purpose (AI trade & business assistant), building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the risk-free trial with 'no card required' to reduce friction and boost conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member. Membership starts at just US$2 per day (billed monthly), giving you unlimited access to Gideon's voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point—what happens at the paywall. It reassures prospects by clearly stating the low entry price, reinforces value with feature highlights, and nudges toward annual billing for better retention. Transparency builds trust and reduces bounce at the conversion moment.
